title: VideoAgent: Long-form Video Understanding with Large Language Model as Agent
layout_note: A long fanned strip of video frames across the top (most greyed out, a few shown in colour); below, three rounded panels in a row (Generate Captions with a VLM icon, an LLM panel with three stacked steps, Retrieve Frames with a CLIP icon); a red line from Retrieve Frames climbs the right edge, runs along the top and drops onto a newly selected frame, closing the loop.
grouping: Each tool or agent is one rounded panel with an olive-green outline and pale fill; the LLM panel holds three orange-outlined step boxes (Predict Answer, Self Reflect, Find Missing Information); the question and the answer are blue-outlined boxes above the panels.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin outlines; line-art icons (eye, chip, lightbulbs, magnifier) at panel corners; the video is a perspective stack of translucent frames with real photos in the selected ones; curved lines from frames down to the caption panel; straight short arrows between panels.
proposed_highlight: No module is singled out; the iteration itself is the emphasis: round-2 items are drawn in red (the new frame's border, the line to it, its caption, the round-2 answers) against olive-green round 1.
lesson: Show two rounds of a loop in one drawing by colouring everything the second round adds (frame border, its line, its caption, its answers) in one accent colour.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv PDF states no venue; remembered venue ECCV 2024 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. Figure 2 of the paper is a detail of the three LLM steps; figure 1 was chosen as the overview. Video frames and icons are embedded images (photo_share). Candidate domain 'agents' written as the knowledge base's 'llm-agents'. flow 'mixed': down from frames to captions, left to right along the panels, then the red return line up and back left along the top.

arrangement.units: a frame strip across the top; three rounded panels in a row below (captioner, LLM agent, retriever), each enclosed by an olive outline
arrangement.inputs_as: a fanned strip of real video frames, most faded grey, the sampled ones in full colour with olive borders and the retrieved one with a red border; a quoted multiple-choice question in a blue box
arrangement.shared: the frame strip is drawn once and read by both rounds; the LLM panel lists round-1 and round-2 results side by side in each step

taxonomy.task: long-form video question answering by an LLM agent that captions sampled frames, self-reflects on its confidence and retrieves more frames with CLIP until confident

insights.structure: The data (frame strip) spans the top and the three actors sit in one row below, so the loop runs down, across and back up over the strip.
insights.data: Frames are real video stills, captions are quoted with timestamps, the retrieval query is quoted, and round results are written in the LLM's step boxes.
insights.emphasis: Colour carries the round: olive for round 1 and red for everything round 2 adds, including the newly retrieved frame.
insights.flow: Curved lines drop from selected frames into the caption panel; short arrows go captions to LLM; a 'Confident?' branch goes Yes up to the answer and No right to Retrieve Frames, from which a red line climbs and runs back along the top to the new frame.
insights.avoid: The return line is a long wire around the whole figure, and the question box floats above the LLM panel with no line to it.

core.what: a loop drawn as a cycle over a frame strip: captions, LLM steps, confidence branch, retrieval, and a red return line to a newly selected frame, with round 2 coloured red

relations.form: Retrieve Frames sends a red line up the right edge and along the top back to a red-bordered frame, which curves down to Generate Captions; round-2 outputs are red text beside olive round-1 text
three panels left to right: Generate Captions, LLM (Predict Answer, Self Reflect, Find Missing Information stacked), Retrieve Frames
the frame strip across the top acts as the store; selected frames are drawn in colour among faded ones and retrieved by the CLIP panel through a quoted query
a 'Confident?' branch between LLM and retriever: Yes goes up to an 'Answer: B' box, No continues right to Retrieve Frames

channels.colour: olive = round 1 (frame borders, curved lines, panel outlines) and red = round 2 (new frame border, its lines, its caption, round-2 answers); orange outlines the LLM's step boxes and the 'Confident?' label; blue outlines the question and answer boxes; the panels' olive outline also means 'module', so olive carries both 'round 1' and 'module'
channels.shape: rounded panels = tools and agent, translucent rectangles = video frames, line icons = which model (VLM, LLM, CLIP)
channels.line: curved lines = frames sent to captioning; straight short arrows = panel to panel; the long red line = loop back to the video
channels.frame: a rounded olive panel = one actor (VLM, LLM, CLIP)

quality.strengths: The loop is the method and is drawn as a cycle over the actual frames; two rounds are shown in one drawing by colour without repeating panels; the data is real (frames, timestamped captions, quoted query, answer); panel-to-panel arrows are short and straight.
quality.weaknesses: The return path is a long red wire around the right and top of the figure; the question box has no connection to the LLM; olive is both round-1 colour and the module outline; orange 'Confident?' introduces a third accent with no keyed meaning.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
